# ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)Daily notes. *Like a magical notebook.*

Start every day in Tana Outliner with a fresh blank page. The place you
can do all your work from: plan your day, track habits, see all tasks
due today, and jot down notes on anything. Use with
[supertags](/supertags) and [search nodes](/search-nodes), and you are
guaranteed to never lose anything again.

## Finally, your stray thoughts have a place to go.

Maintain focus by using the daily page as a place to save things for
later. In the middle of one thing but had a brilliant thought related to
another? Use Quick Add to save that thought to your daily notes for
later processing. Even better, use [supertags](/supertags) to send your
thoughts to their right place, instantly.

## Every day starts with a clean canvas, ready to get messy with you.

There is nothing like starting the day with a clean countertop. No need
to feel guilty about cleaning up from last night — Tana Outliner gives
you a brand new go at things every day, no questions asked. Unlike in
other tools, the app always has a natural place to start your day with
planning and review of what needs to be done. Bring over only what you
need from previous days, so you can focus on just that. References
ensure you are working on the same things no matter what day you choose
to work on them.

## Use the daily notes page to create and maintain focus.

The daily page is your partner in creating and maintaining focus, while
getting tasks done. It receives anything, and can be anything you need
it to be for today. Use the supertag template to assemble your most
important tasks, the projects you want to focus on, your agenda for the
day.

Make your daily notes page your daily *driver*.

## Questions and answers

Can I open the day node of another workspace by default?

It is not possible to change which workspace's day node opens by
default. It is fixed to your private workspace's day node.

However, you can open the sidebar and hold Option (Mac) or Alt (Windows)
while clicking on a workspace to open its day node for today.

How can I get the task list on my daily notes back?

You may have seen a Tana Outliner setup that had a task list on the
daily notes page, or had one from our early prototypes that has since
disappeared. There is a simple way to get it back.

Go to any daily note and make a search that looks for:

-   all \#task nodes
-   NOT DONE

Run it to confirm it is fetching the right things. Adjust how you want
your tasks to look (set Display, Group, and Sort options here). Confirm
changes to the view options and the query, then right-click the title of
the search and select Move to Related content.

How can I set up Unsplash banners on my daily notes?

You can plug in your own Unsplash API key to get access to their images
for the banners of your daily notes page. Ambassador Andre has a
walkthrough of the setup on X.

This is an experimental feature and may change in the future.
